speech.heard: Iceland gets 88.9% of its energy from clean sources. Nigeria gets just 1.3%. At the world's lowest end, Turkmenistan relies on 0% clean energy. The USA gets 14.1% clean energy, but Iceland has 6.3 times that share. India gets just 4.5% clean energy. Sweden gets 51.7%, France 51.4%, Paraguay 49.9% and Norway 48.9%. China sits at 10.7%, far behind the leaders. How much clean energy powers your country?
